output.reasoning: Several hard criteria fail. (1) Role type: 'Applied AI Architect, Partnerships' is a pre-sales, customer- and partner-facing architect role. The work is cultivating relationships with GSIs/RSIs and cloud partners, supporting GTM strategy, unblocking deals, evangelizing at events and giving technical enablement. It is not hands-on engineering that builds, trains and deploys ML/NLP systems, and it does not match her target roles (ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, Research Engineer). (2) Level: the posting asks for 5+ years in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer or Technical Account Manager. That is well above the 3+ year cutoff. Ananya is a new grad finishing her MS in CS (AI concentration) at Boston University in 2026-12, and her only industry experience is an 8-month ML Engineer co-op at Lumenwise Health. (3) Location: the role is based in Munich, Germany, with a 25% in-office hybrid policy. It is not US-based and not designated Remote. Her willingness to relocate covers only the US. (4) Skills: the requirements list AWS and GCP as partner context plus a general familiarity with LLM frameworks. AWS overlaps with her shipped skills, but this does not offset the failures on role, level and location. (5) Sponsorship: Anthropic says it does sponsor visas, so this criterion would pass, but it does not change the outcome.
